Sahil Kumar
Senior Node.js Developer | Bangalore
sahil.kumar885@example.com | +91 9964407231

Experienced backend engineer focused on building scalable Node.js services and improving operational reliability. Skilled at designing microservice architectures, implementing GraphQL APIs, and containerizing applications for repeatable deployments. Strong collaborator across product and QA teams, with a track record of reducing latency and improving throughput.

Experience
Quanta Retail — Jan 2023 - Present
Senior Node.js Developer, Remote
- Architected and implemented a Node.js order-processing service that handled 20k+ daily orders, reducing average checkout latency by 45% using optimized async flows and Redis caching.
- Containerized core services with Docker and introduced a multi-stage build pipeline, cutting image sizes by 60% and decreasing CI pipeline runtime by 35%.
- Led migration of a monolithic inventory module to Microservices patterns, enabling independent scaling and reducing deployment failure rate by 50%.
- Collaborated via Jira and Confluence to implement SLO-driven monitoring and on-call runbooks, improving mean time to recovery (MTTR) by 40%.

Ledgerly — Mar 2019 - Dec 2022
Node.js Developer, Hybrid
- Designed and developed a GraphQL gateway in Node JS to unify disparate billing and ledger services, improving developer productivity and reducing API calls by 30%.
- Built resilient data sync jobs using Node JS and Redis to de-duplicate transactions, resulting in a 99.98% data consistency rate across systems.
- Implemented schema-driven validation and performance tracing that identified and resolved slow queries, improving 95th percentile response times by 55%.
- Documented API contracts and onboarding flows in Confluence and tracked feature delivery through Jira, shortening new-feature lead time by 20%.

Medisure — Mar 2016 - Feb 2019
Backend Engineer, On-site
- Developed Express.js microservices for patient record ingestion and retrieval, scaling to support a 3x increase in concurrent users without downtime.
- Implemented service-to-service communication patterns for Microservices, including retry/backoff and circuit breaker logic, reducing error propagation by 60%.
- Optimized DB access and introduced Redis caching for frequently read endpoints, cutting average response times from 400ms to 120ms.
- Coordinated releases and sprint planning via Jira and maintained technical runbooks in Confluence to streamline handovers.

Projects
Inventory Scaling Tool
- Built a Dockerized tool to simulate high-load inventory scenarios against Quanta Retail services, enabling capacity planning up to 100k orders/hour.

Schema Migration Assistant
- Developed a Node JS utility to perform safe GraphQL schema migrations with rollbacks and automated compatibility checks used at Ledgerly.

Skills
Languages: Node JS, TS
Frameworks & APIs: Express.js, GraphQL
Datastores & Cache: Redis
DevOps & Containers: Docker
Architecture & Processes: Microservices, Jira, Confluence

Education
B.Com, Narsee Monjee College
